evidence.quote:
Regarding Table 5: I recommend reconsidering the presentation of regression results based on a
very small sample (N=39). With such limited observations, the statistical power is questionable and
results may be unstable. As an alternative, you might consider adding an interaction term
between 'crisis parties' and populism to the main analysis, which would allow you to test the
conditional relationship while maintaining adequate sample size. If you retain the separate
analysis, please discuss the limitations explicitly and consider reporting measures of model fit and
diagnostics to assess reliability.

Dear reviewer, 
Thank you for your thoughtful review and helpful comments. They are greatly appreciated.
We have reviewed your points, alongside the feedback from the other reviewers. We are
currently preparing the revised manuscript and will incorporate your input as we work
toward the final resubmission.
[closing signature omitted]

[Next author response post]


Dear reviewer, 
We are pleased to submit the revised version of our manuscript, following the valuable
feedback provided by the reviewers.
We have comprehensively addressed all comments and suggestions. We have incorporated
numerous editorial and stylistic changes throughout the text to enhance clarity and
analytical rigor, as you recommended. Crucially, we have reorganized the literature review
around thematic topics, as suggested. Furthermore, we have integrated our theoretical
framework with the reformulated hypotheses (which have been decomposed for greater
specificity) to provide a stronger justification for our approach. We have also refined the
operationalization of "crisis parties" and eliminated the Table 5. Finally, we have enhanced
the concluding section by more explicitly discussing our findings in relation to previous
research and clearly delineating their contribution, ensuring the entire text adheres to a
consistently formal and appropriate academic tone.
We believe that these revisions have resulted in a significantly more robust and consistent
version of the manuscript. We [closing signature omitted]
